text:
Anya (Docs): Quick heads-up — I opened a small PR to consolidate function-calling examples across the structured-output guide. https://git.company/infra/docs/pulls/498
Michael (SDK): Saw it, thanks. Is this just markdown edits or are we changing the code snippets for v2 sdk?
Anya (Docs): Mostly MD and link fixes, but I swapped one JS snippet to the new `invoke` helper pattern so it uses `client.invoke({ model, input })` not `client.generate()`.
Sylvia (Eng-ML): That's fine, but please keep the old example somewhere — some customers still on older SDK versions. Maybe add a short compatibility note?
Anya (Docs): Good call. I'll add an expandable note block.
Josh (Product): Can we also add a short migration checklist for function outputs -> JSON schema guardrails? A few customers asked about ambiguous arrays.
Samir (Docs): I started a TODO in the PR description for that. My plan: 1) small checklist 2) a canonical schema example for tool responses 3) a parsing snippet that validates and falls back.
Michael (SDK): For the parsing snippet, can we provide both sync and streaming patterns? Streaming parsing has edge cases with partial JSON.
Anya (Docs): I'll add both. For streaming I'll include this pattern:

`````
let buffer = '';
for await (const chunk of client.stream(response)) {
  buffer += chunk;
  // attempt incremental parse
}
const parsed = tryParse(buffer) || fallback();
`````

Michael (SDK): Perfect. Also please change the snippet where we call tools to use `tool.call({ name, input })` — our SDK now wraps tool metadata in the `tools` namespace.
Anya (Docs): Will update.
Samir (Docs): Link fixes: there are three outdated links to old schema doc. I left inline comments where they should point to /docs/structured-output/schema-v2.md
Sylvia (Eng-ML): For the canonical schema, suggest this shape for a tool that returns a list of entities:

`````
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "entities": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": {"id": {"type":"string"}, "score": {"type":"number"}}}}
  },
  "required": ["entities"]
}
`````

Samir (Docs): Nice. I'll paste that into the PR and add a brief note about nullability and empty arrays.
Josh (Product): We also need a small blurb in the release notes — customers should know about the snippet and SDK rename.
Anya (Docs): I'll draft a short changelog line.
Michael (SDK): One more: can we add a lint step in the docs CI that runs a tiny validator against included JSON examples? Catches copy-paste errors.
Sylvia (Eng-ML): I can throw together a `scripts/validate-examples.py` that loads JSON blocks from MD and runs jsonschema validate. Will create a draft branch and ping.
Anya (Docs): Amazing — can you open a PR for that and add it to the docs CI job? If it's small we can merge before the examples PR.
Sylvia (Eng-ML): Yep, targeting EOD.
dev-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploys.company/docs/preview/2345679000
Samir (Docs): Final ask — can someone from support glance at the migration checklist? Might be subtle for customers re: optional fields.
Josh (Product): I'll loop in Maya from Support.
Anya (Docs): Thank you everyone — I'll push updates in the next hour and tag reviewers. :rocket:
Michael (SDK): LGTM, thanks.
Maya (Support): (joined) Quick read — will give feedback by noon.
Samir (Docs): Updated PR with compatibility note, canonical schema, link fixes, and the streaming snippet.
Anya (Docs): Merging once CI is green. If anything else pops up, drop it here.
